title: In Dropping Reflecting Pool Case, Pirro Draws Trump’s Wrath
summary: Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney in Washington, blamed shoddy construction, contradicting President Trump’s pet theory. Mr. Trump said he disagreed “100%” with her.
